chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Khadir, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever is prejudicial (shows bias/tribalism), Allah will join him with a gang from the Fire.

key_terms.تَعَصَّبَ: He showed prejudice, bias, or partisan loyalty (ta'assub)
key_terms.عَصَبِيَّة: Tribalism, bias, or partisan spirit (implied by the root)
key_terms.عِصَابَةٍ: A gang, group, or band (often referring to a group of people or a specific type of grouping)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of showing prejudice or tribal bias according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links *ta'assub* (tribal or partisan bias) to divine retribution, warning that the biased will be bound (*'isabah*) specifically with a 'binding of fire.' This concept is foundational in Shia ethics, illustrating how social prejudice corrupts spiritual integrity and leads to exclusion from the community of the faithful. The imagery of being 'bound' suggests that such bias becomes an inescapable tether to the Hellfire, emphasizing the severity of internalizing tribalism.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Khazr, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who is prejudicial, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Join him with a gang from the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 4. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Khudr from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
On the Day of Judgment Allah will join those who practice racial discrimination with a race in fire.”
